name: comma
title: Comma
description: Ask Comma, find your Tasks, and open Comma from Raycast.
author: zanwei_guo

commands.name: ask-comma
commands.title: Ask Comma
commands.description: Send a message to Comma. Before you connect, it asks whether to connect.

commands.name: search-tasks
commands.title: Search Tasks
commands.description: Find a Task and open it in Comma. Its actions open Comma and disconnect the extension.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Comma Menu Bar
commands.description: Show your active Tasks in the menu bar.

commands.name: switch-workspace
commands.title: Switch Workspace
commands.description: Choose the Workspace that Ask Comma and Search Tasks use.

commands.name: connect
commands.title: Connect Comma
commands.description: Connect this extension to your Comma account. You confirm in the Comma app.

preferences.name: environment
preferences.title: Comma Environment
preferences.description: The Comma app and server this extension talks to.
